question: Which CPU-visible stores and unresolved readers prevent an unconditional tiling replay-worker bypass?

scope.boundary: Bounded static store and reader classification. No exhaustive alias analysis, actual callback binding, host implementation or runtime safety result.

dependencies.use: Owns the mapped-program versus supported-flat input qualification; cited semantic native windows avoid every mismatch range.
Owns the separate allocation, fence and EndTiling reservation contracts.
Owns qualified worker event waits and conditional presentation order.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only no-analysis queries through tools/run-headless.ps1 using ghidra/DumpFunctions.java, ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java, ghidra/FindPointerValues.java, ghidra/DumpReferences.java and ghidra/FindDirectCallers.java; narrow exact-function generated corroboration.
currentEvidence.decompilerLimit: Canonical function bodies truncate at Xenon save thunks or undecoded instructions. Native word windows support the listed instruction sites; sparse decoded-reference absence is not a reader-absence proof.
currentEvidence.inputQualification: native-renderer-shader-fetch-patch-boundary.json#/currentEvidence/inputQualification applies. Broad raw scan counts describe that mapped program, not an exhaustive reader census of an unmodified image.

objectIdentity.claim: The selected constructor arm stores W=G+0x2AC0 and CPU ordinal i into Q_i+0 and Q_i+4, where Q_i=G+0x2C3C+80*i, and supplies Q_i to the materialized 0x826ABEA8 thread entry.
objectIdentity.qualification: Current object identity, successful initialization, CPU selection and lifetime remain conditional.

storeFamilies.claim: Reservation loops increment the word before each event wait and decrement it afterward.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The same reservation loops read the word. Other aliases and imported-kernel effects are not closed.

storeFamilies.claim: Reservation loops acquire the worker lock, can rewrite its old word on a failed comparison, and release it with zero.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Worker lock loops read the word; all external aliases remain unknown.

storeFamilies.claim: The interpreter updates loop ordinals, payload and continuation pointers, CPU participation, pending/current lists and the per-CPU queue consumer.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The interpreter, end-of-list handler and thread queue comparisons read these fields. This does not classify every image reader.

storeFamilies.claim: Token 0x8C000000 installs a function pointer and context from the following two words. The interpreter later loads the pointer and calls it indirectly.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The actual installed target, transitive writes and their nonworker readers are unresolved.

storeFamilies.claim: The interpreter updates phase/barrier words and a token-supplied mask. It spins on W+0x60 at 0x826ABE24 and compares the barrier count against W+0x3C.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Same-worker readers are identified; exhaustive nonworker readers remain unknown.

storeFamilies.claim: Token arms store flags, nesting, masks, list checkpoints and pending work. The call at 0x826AB8A8 requests a 248-byte copy into W+0x6C.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Token/interpreter and mask-builder readers are identified. The copy effect uses the separate memcpy interpretation; aliases and transitive helpers are qualified.

storeFamilies.claim: End-of-list processing updates continuation and CPU masks, decrements active participation, advances selected queue consumers and conditionally decrements W+0x40=G+0x2B00 when participation reaches zero and W+0x48 is null.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Submit and drain read G+0x2B00. Queue consumers alias Q_i+0x3C and are read by the thread/interpreter. Other readers are not closed.

storeFamilies.claim: The deferred arm appends submit, address and terminator words, links them through 0x8269B550, then adds incoming r7 to G+0x2B00. The direct arm also adds incoming r7 before submit.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: The replay token parser reads the appended words. Keeping the counter zero requires handling the direct-arm add as well as the deferred arm.

storeFamilies.destination: first word, descriptor+0x4/+0x8 and old tail word
storeFamilies.claim: The helper publishes translated list links and updates descriptor first/tail pointers, with two cache-coherency calls.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Worker list traversal is identified. Arbitrary descriptor and tail aliases are not closed.

storeFamilies.claim: Queue push stores incoming r3 in a four-slot ring, increments its producer and signals its event.
storeFamilies.readerBoundary: Worker queue and event-wait readers are identified; kernel effects and all aliases remain qualified.

externalWriteFrontiers.inputForm: Generated parser corroboration at0x826AB9D0 supplies P from record+4 of the0x8A000000 form; record+8/+12/+16 are companion payload words. The bounded producer packet did not identify that record's constructor or P allocation/readers.
externalWriteFrontiers.claim: Stores a computed word through a destination loaded from the input list. It is not statically bounded to the device or a proved ring allocation.
Stores a computed word through another list-selected destination. Current destination and reader identity remain unknown.
Writes a computed overlap mask through a list-selected destination; all CPU aliases are not enumerated.
Writes computed mask OR 0x80000000 at a record-selected pointer+0x8. Intended command-placeholder use does not prove absence of CPU readers.

Updates W+0x38, selected CPU descriptor words at G+0x2C44/+0x2C48/+0x2C4C/+0x2C50+80*i and commands rooted at [G+0x2E1C]. Per-CPU pointer waits remain at 0x826AB31C..0x826AB338 and 0x826AB3C0:0x826AB408..0x826AB424.

Sets W+0x68 and, after KeLockL2, runs cache-line zero operations over scratch rooted at 0x7F100000 with input-selected length 0x20000 or 0x40000. Mapping, imported effects and external readers remain qualified.
Updates index word 0x82FA0540 and CPU/log-value pairs rooted at 0x82F9C540. These are CPU-visible diagnostic writes; their reader set is not closed.
Conditional vtable+0x18/+0x1C calls through G+0x541C and callback G+0x5B0C remain unresolved. The direct path also owns command-ring, G+0x2AC8 and MMIO writes.

replayProducerBoundary.submitForm: Deferred0x8269BD98 writes0x81000000|incoming_r6 at descriptor+4, incoming_r5 at+8 and0xC0000000 at+12, then links through0x8269B550. The direct arm masks r6 to24 bits before ORing0x81000000 into a local two-word record. The deferred form's class requires a bound r6; do not infer an unrestricted high byte is always0x81.
replayProducerBoundary.pointerFrontier: D320 uses context L=G+0x3438 and can obtain storage through0x8269C170 at0x8269D590/0x8269D5C0/0x8269D654. Sites0x8269D5A4/0x8269D630/0x8269D674 store the updated cursor to G+0x3440=L+8; they are not helper calls. Separately C400 calls0x8269BCA8 at0x8269C508 after argument setup at0x8269C500..0x8269C504. The eighth function bounds the storage cursor below; BCA8 finalization, allocator/fallback ownership and a concrete retained title list remain unbound.

storageCursor.claim: For context L, calls0x8269B818([L+16],r4=4224,r5=128). Success selects returned H, writes encoded alias links and calls0x826A72F8 over a4224-byte span. On a zero return it selects H=[[L+16]+0x4158] and clears L+0 instead. Both returning paths set L+4=H,L+8=H+4,L+12=H+4220 and return H+4.
storageCursor.qualification: This identifies caller-managed linked command storage and a fallback, not allocator units, allocation generation, extent validity, imported/cache effects or all readers. B818, fallback ownership and BCA8 remain the stop frontier at the eight-function cap.

replayProducerBoundary.emitterNegative: No literal0x8A000000..0x8E000000 constructor was identified in these seven exact bodies. The nonparser lis0x8C00 candidates were numeric/text data contexts, not compatible emitter evidence. This is not an all-producer census or proof that0x8C cannot be copied/computed/emitted elsewhere.
replayProducerBoundary.corroboration: Canonical rerevved generated/default exact functions named above, observed HEAD81798450751cfb75460269f82c2eb4df02754e80; native words confirmed the listed header/store/call sites.
replayProducerBoundary.qualification: These are conditional static construction paths, not runtime token observations. Parser recognition, descriptor shape and literal scans do not bind actual0x8C function/context or list-selected result allocations/readers. The bounded packet stopped at the retained allocator/fallback/publication frontier.

endTilingSubmitBoundary.claim: There is an optional earlier submit guarded by a stack word from 0x8269BAE8 in addition to two later submits. The middle submit passes r7=1; the final submit passes r7=0.

optionalCount.outputs: When n is zero or 0x8269B818 returns zero, incoming r5 receives zero. Otherwise incoming r5 receives n (11 or22), and incoming r4 receives the encoded allocated buffer address. AC218 supplies outer stack+0x50 as incoming r5, so this command count gates 0x826AC364.
optionalCount.localDistinction: Atomic helper 0x8269B3F8 returns the old G+0x2E30 low/high words to 9BAE8's local frame and replaces the qword with the sentinel. Those local words are not AC218's outer count output.
optionalCount.corroboration: Canonical rerevved generated/default/rerevved_recomp.97.cpp:12715-13006 and rerevved_recomp.98.cpp:12772-12846 at observed HEAD81798450751cfb75460269f82c2eb4df02754e80.
optionalCount.qualification: This is the normal returning branch condition, not observed input values, allocation success, synchronization or activation frequency. Allocator and emitted-command effects remain part of the boundary.

endTilingSubmitBoundary.qualification: Changing only the two later submits does not cover the optional arm. Direct routing alone does not suppress the counter add.

sinkWriterBoundary.claim: The selector34 arm stores incoming r4 to G+0x5B0C after following *(*0x820009F0), the accepted published-device chain, and testing the object, object+0x3C and qword+0x2A80 guards.
sinkWriterBoundary.registration: An aligned literal at 0x82185668 contains 0x826A9810 followed by descriptor0x40007603. A raw initialized-executable direct-LK scan found zero callers, cap32 not truncated; this does not prove the registered function unused.
sinkWriterBoundary.writerSearch: Exact-displacement scalar forms found no G+0x541C or G+0x3478 writer. The maintained bounded store scan in [0x82680000,0x826C0000) examined65536 words for offsets0x5418/0x541C/0x5B08/0x5B0C/0x3474/0x3478, cap64, two matches: this setter and a nonoverlapping stw at0x8269B10C with displacement0x3474.
sinkWriterBoundary.corroboration: Canonical rerevved generated/default/rerevved_recomp.83.cpp:12796-12857 at observed HEAD81798450751cfb75460269f82c2eb4df02754e80; native-renderer-d3d-runtime-surface.json identifies the same published-device chain at0x82698258.
sinkWriterBoundary.qualification: No actual selector34 dispatch, installed function value, nonnull shipped-title sink or vtable target was established. Different-base, indexed, bulk and runtime writers remain possible. Retain or model the indirect calls.

watchdogBoundary.claim: The watchdog reads G+0x3478 before and after 0x826A57B8. A zero reread reaches diagnostics and a trap at 0x826A5BEC. On the selected nonzero/global-zero arm it sets device flags, writes [G+0x2A9C]-2 to *[G+0x2A90], zeroes G+0x2B00 and calls 0x826A7BE8.
watchdogBoundary.defaultCallbacks: A5B48 supplies zero callback arguments, selecting0x826A53B0 and0x826A53C0 in A57B8. Their native bodies read a word or write incoming r4 plus eieio at address U(0x7FC80000+4*incoming_r3), respectively. They are MMIO accessors, not unspecified logging callbacks.
watchdogBoundary.defaultMmioSequence: A57B8 reads register ordinals0x5D0,0xF26(discarded),0x1C0,0x57B,0x57C,0x57D,0x57A; writes12 to0xC80 at call0x826A5874; then reads0xC81 five times. Address translation is the defaultCallbacks formula. The shown sequence does not restore0xC80.
watchdogBoundary.localStores: A57B8 directly stores stack+0xA0..+0xAC at0x826A5894/0x826A58A4/0x826A58B4/0x826A58C4 and stack+0x90..+0x98 at0x826A58CC/0x826A58D0/0x826A58D8, in addition to frame/save stores. No direct G store was identified in its body; direct diagnostic-helper and MMIO effects are separate.
watchdogBoundary.qualification: The actual G+0x3478 writer/value, complete helper/MMIO effects, timing units and activation remain qualified. A raw direct-LK scan found call0x8268CC68; this is not runtime activation proof. Nonzero custom callback arguments require their own target/effect binding.

readerSearchBoundary.parameters: Aligned initialized-memory words of the qualified mapped program, mask 0xFC00FFFF, cap 256 per pattern.
readerSearchBoundary.claim: Five candidates are the known submit/drain reads. The other three match pointer values in data tables rather than additional G-relative load sites; their bounded classifications follow.

dataCandidates.classification: Pointer/count/flag table interpretation from neighboring records; not a proved extra device load.
Function-pointer/descriptor table interpretation from neighboring pairs; not a proved extra device load.
Jump-table entry252 at base0x82C3216C. Native materialization/indexed load/dispatch at 0x82C32154..0x82C32168 establishes the table role.

readerSearchBoundary.dataCorroboration: Canonical rerevved generated/default/rerevved_recomp.106.cpp:44115-44160,45513-45524 at observed HEAD81798450751cfb75460269f82c2eb4df02754e80. Sparse decoded exact references and containing-function queries were empty for the three candidates; those negatives alone do not establish data identity.
readerSearchBoundary.qualification: This is not exhaustive reader analysis. Worker-relative, indexed, overlapping, byte/halfword, bulk-copy, indirect and dynamic accesses remain possible. A zero result for one encoding does not prove absence of aliases.

guards: Do not call a list-selected destination ring-only without binding its allocation and every relevant CPU reader.
Do not infer an installed callback from a token opcode or address proximity.
Do not replace the entire 0x826ABEA8 thread when only replay queue work is under consideration; it retains a conditional presentation path.
Do not infer runtime progress, GPU completion, release ordering or host-model parity from this static result.
No exhaustive main-thread, callback or interrupt reader inventory was established.
nextDiscriminators: Bind the actual token stream, 0x8C payload and W+0x10/+0x14 before the 0x826ABD6C call, then inspect the actual target within a bounded native read set.
Bind allocations and readers for each list-selected result and mask destination at 0x826AB4C8,0x826AB60C,0x826AB6FC,0x826AB120.
Bind actual W/Q pointer publications and indirect or overlapping aliases before claiming a reader closure; the three raw data-word hits do not add G-relative readers.
Bind G+0x3478's producer and the retained 0x826A57B8 effects; verify the optional submit and both counter-add sites.
A separately authorized default-off bracket probe must compare all predicted non-ring writes and record later alias reads, callbacks, waits and release ordering.
conclusion: The worker chain writes CPU-visible device, queue, list-selected, diagnostic and scratch state and contains unresolved indirect calls. The proposed broad replay bypass has no static safety proof. No concrete runtime blocking reader or safe refusal set is claimed.
